fileLockDelegation.why: Only SharedUtils opens a lock FileStream; every module calls Enter-BuildFileLock. The Semaphore primitive used by DeployTargets.Enter-DeployLock is a separate, machine-wide primitive and is intentionally not counted by this class (a lock here is cross-process, not a FileStream over a path)

eventNameRegistry.metric: quoted EVT_* literals at production publish sites
eventNameRegistry.why: Publishers use the EventBus EVT_* constants instead of repeating the string

sharedUtilsImportOwner.metric: inline Join-Path $PSScriptRoot SharedUtils.psm1 sites outside the exempt bootstrap root
sharedUtilsImportOwner.why: The lazy SharedUtils import has one owner in ModuleBootstrap.ps1 (Logging.psm1 is the bootstrap root and is registered exempt)

stringHashDelegation.metric: production files that build a string hash inline: UTF8.GetBytes -> assigned variable -> ComputeHash(that variable) -> hex
stringHashDelegation.why: UTF8->SHA256->hex over a STRING goes through the shared Get-BuildStringHash; byte-stream file digests are a separate concern and are not counted

platformPathLiterals.metric: files constructing a repository path with a backslash separator (production and test)
platformPathLiterals.why: No shipped file constructs a repository path with a hardcoded Windows backslash separator, so a path built here resolves on POSIX too (production Modules/Steps/Hooks AND the test suite are both scanned)

localeKeyWiring.why: Every shipped locale key is reachable from code (no translated strings nobody reads)

i18nProseCoverage.metric: log emit sites whose message argument carries translatable English but no locale resolver
i18nProseCoverage.why: User-facing log PROSE routes through a locale resolver (separators, ASCII art and relayed tool output are excluded from the denominator and counted as summary.EmitSitesNonProse; every emit verb is scanned at every position on the line, including Write-Host, Write-Warning and throw; production entry scripts at the tool root are in scope)
